capabilities: Edit raw CSV text with Rainbow CSV style highlighting
View CSV data as a formatted table
Toggle between source and table modes in the editor
Edit cell values directly in table mode
Save changes directly to the .csv file
extras: The author says the plugin was built quickly for personal needs and will not be actively maintained, though easy suggestions may be picked up. Only strictly comma-separated values are supported; semicolons and tabs are not.
motivation: The author built it after being unable to find an Obsidian plugin that offered both Rainbow CSV color coding and easy viewing/editing of CSVs as raw text or a table.
problem: Obsidian has no native CSV viewing or editing, and no existing plugin combined Rainbow CSV color coding with both raw-text and table views.

relations.evidence: Native CSV viewing and editing in Obsidian with Rainbow CSV style highlighting.

summary: CSV viewer and editor that opens .csv files in source mode with Rainbow CSV highlighting or as an editable table.
